contracts: Four complete generated module factories publish separate metadata, checker and behavior registrations; custom Priority registrations replace their default counterparts.
Original query_behavior and behavior return None during generated schema bootstrap. Native behavior follows the same suppression.

Actual public prepare_insert_command calls Behavior, then RequestPolicy, ID/version defaults and registered check_and_fix_values. prepare_update_command calls Behavior, then RequestPolicy, without a second Checker preflight.
Ordinary generated audited entity save retains its graph/ledger entry point. It exercises Checker and query Behavior but does not imply invocation of command-preparation write hooks.

Custom typed resource belongs to UserContext. Native observation and destruction counter belong to GlobalContext; emitted strings/commands/results are explicit destination copies before actual User deletion.
